title: 1890s airship mystery and NYMZA, per Walter Bosley and Joseph Farrell

tellings.quote: What I'm worried about is uh Walter Bosley, you know, the friend of Dr. Joseph Pharaoh, Walter Bosley, the whole idea of Nenza. Who the were these guys? The airship quote unquote mystery.

related.note: Both are about the 1890s airship sightings. The story treats them as culturally shaped perception, while this telling, following Bosley and Farrell, ties them to a real secret group called NYMZA.

plain: In the 1890s, people across the United States reported mysterious airships in the sky. A researcher named Walter Bosley, a friend of a Dr. Joseph P. Farrell, ties those sightings to a group he calls NYMZA. Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual craft designs, brings this up in passing without explaining what the group was. He says the idea worries him and asks who these people really were, since it would mean someone was flying craft in secret long before anyone was supposed to be able to.
